items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: with Joe Glazer at that time, you know.

ctx.x: What club was that, do you know? What year was it?

Oh, it was way before I met him. Somewhere in the '30s. You know. But to hear the guys tell the story, I'm not as comical as they are. Of course I wasn't there. I'm just trying to remember bits and pieces of the story, you know? And Stuff got lonesome for his wife and

drove all the way back to Buffalo, New York. And they -- pretty soon they caught up with him, you know. But one of the reasons that John became -- he was the -- John Levy, I mean. He was the business man of the trio, because when I joined Stuff in Chicago the union wouldn't let Stuff handle the salaries. So John Levy was doing the business, with Joe Glazer at that time, you know. And when John would get sick I would do it. And Stuff would have to go to the union to get his money. Because --
